approved_basis: User request of 2026-09-30: test whether all four detection baselines improve when noise optimization uses up to eight hours per method.
Prior user limit: preserve each method's inner computation and sampling, while permitting complete outer-cycle count changes; independent random YOLOv8n victim remains 200 epochs.
implementation_intent: Distinct eight-hour compute-budget sensitivity variant for EM-Det, REM-Det, EntF-Push-Det and SEM-Det. Preserve per-block equations, data and victim protocol; persist perturbations and surrogate optimizer across full passes. Explicitly override EM's original train-error early stop only in this variant; extend EntF by continuing the same delta through additional 300-step Push blocks.
